title: Review a settlement from draft to paid
caption: Needs FEATURE_SETTLEMENTS. Mirrors admin-settlements.e2e.ts (which seeds a draft with insertDraftSettlement).

steps.title: Open the drafts
steps.body: **To review** → 'draft settlements to review' (→ `/settlements?status=draft`), open the statement.
steps.expect: Totals (payments, refunds, disputes, Stripe fees, Velexis fee with rate, adjustments, net), lines with CSV link, payout account status.

steps.title: Add an adjustment
steps.body: **Add an adjustment**: signed amount in the statement currency, description (the OTA sees it), reason → **Add adjustment**.
steps.expect: A new `adjustment` line; totals recomputed. `1500.5` on a JPY statement is refused at the field (0 decimals).

steps.title: Approve
steps.body: **Approve** → **Approve statement** → code in 'Confirm with your authenticator app' if asked.
steps.expect: Net > 0 → approved (needs a verified payout account: else `PAYOUT_ACCOUNT_REQUIRED`); net ≤ 0 → carried_forward.

steps.title: Pay and record
steps.body: Reveal the bank details on the OTA's payout account, pay outside Velexis, then **Record the bank transfer** (day, bank reference) → **Mark paid** (+ code).
steps.expect: Status paid; owners get 'Velexis paid the <month> settlement of <OTA>'; the portal shows the statement paid with its CSV.
